parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: A nucleus of sodium-22 ($^{22}_{11}\text{Na}$) decays by emitting a $\beta^+$ particle. A different nucleus is formed by the decay.
parts.text: State the name of another lepton that is produced by the decay.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the nucleon number and the proton number of the nucleus that is formed by the decay.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
The quark composition of a nucleon in the sodium-22 nucleus is changed during the decay.

Describe the change to the quark composition of the nucleon.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: A baryon consists of quarks that are the same flavour (type). The charge of the baryon is $-2e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge.
parts.text: Calculate, in terms of $e$, the charge of each quark.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State a possible flavour (type) of the quarks.
